blocks.text: Hypothesis testing ek tareeqa hai jis se data ki madad se faisle kiye jate hain. Yeh check karta hai ke koi assumption (farz ki hui baat) sach hai ya ghalat. Yeh tareeqa research aur analysis mein bohat istemal hota hai. Hypothesis testing ek wazeh process par chalti hai jo assumptions ko accept (qabool) ya reject (radd) karne mein madad deti hai. Data dhyan se jama aur analyze kiya jata hai. Yeh tareeqa andaze (guesswork) ko kam karta hai kyunke faisle saboot (evidence) par hote hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Hypothesis testing data se assumptions check karti hai. Yeh faisla karne mein madad deti hai ke koi daawa (claim) sach hai ya nahi. Yeh research aur experiments (tajrubat) mein use hoti hai. Yeh andaze kam karti hai. Nataij sahi testing par depend karte hain.
